items.name: session
items.title: Session bindings
items.description: One authenticated transport, typed client, TanStack Query client and live invalidation bindings for the local instance.

items.name: native-dialog
items.title: Native dialog
items.description: Modal on the native <dialog> element: focus trap, Escape and inert background without injected <style> tags, so it works under a strict CSP.

items.name: capability-form
items.title: Capability form
items.description: A complete form for any command capability, generated from its JSON Schema and display metadata, with contract validation, a per-form idempotency key and field-level server errors. Fields render by kind: date and date-time inputs, a checkbox, a picker over a referenced collection, a file input that uploads to the blob store. With a record's values it edits that record, and emptying a field clears it. A prefill from an OS request fills the fields and shows its provenance; the person still submits.

items.name: live-data-table
items.title: Live data table
items.description: TanStack Table over a server-scoped, server-paginated capability query; never filters or counts client-side.

items.name: collection-screen
items.title: Collection screens
items.description: Default list and record screens for a collection's generated get and list queries and its create, update, move and retire commands. The list renders the filters, sort and search the query declares and formats cells by kind; the record screen edits the record's values and confirms a retire. Replace them one route at a time.

items.name: collection-tree
items.title: Collection tree
items.description: A tree collection depth first from its generated tree query, indented by depth, with a slot for per-record badges and actions, a search box over its list, and a form for its create command.

items.name: conflict-banner
items.title: Conflict banner
items.description: Shown when committed data moved past a draft's base revision; rebase or discard, never overwrite.

items.name: approval-review
items.title: ApprovalRequest review
items.description: Pending approvals, live, with what each would run and why; Approve runs the command as the signed-in person and Reject closes it.

items.name: reconciliation-review
items.title: Reconciliation review
items.description: Held deliveries, live, with what was sent and why it is held; the person says whether the target applied it, which completes it, sends it again or completes it as refused.

items.name: assignment-board
items.title: Assignment board
items.description: Assignments, live, with stage, assignee and report counts; a form per kind that creates a draft or sends at once; and Send, Withdraw and Close where the stage allows them. Slots per kind: the scope editor and a summary of what an assignment covers.

items.name: assignment-reports
items.title: Assignment reports
items.description: Reports, live, with body, reporter and review state; link a report to a subject, discard it, or accept it with the reviewer's input. Slots per kind: the body view, the subject's name, the linking input and the accept form.

items.name: my-assignments
items.title: My assignments
items.description: The assignments sent to the signed-in person, live, each with its instructions, a report form and Done. Slots per kind: the instructions view and the report form, generated from the kind's report when omitted.

items.name: worklist
items.title: Worklist
items.description: The work an issuer sent here, live, with a report form per kind, Done, and every report with whether the issuer took it; the counts and last inbound sync from the worklist target's status. Slots per kind: the instructions view, the report form, the body view and the subject's name.

items.name: run-panel
items.title: Agent run panel
items.description: Recent agent runs with inline answers to questions and approvals.

items.name: assistant-panel
items.title: Assistant panel
items.description: A panel beside every screen that talks to the application's agent definitions through the run route, with the conversation the host keeps, questions, approvals, review requests and the records of the current screen.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Capability palette
items.description: ⌘K palette over the discovered contract: the human mirror of an agent's tool list.

items.name: screens
items.title: Application screens contract
items.description: The declaration an application hands the frame: routes, navigation, the screen each capability family opens, the screen that shows each selectable resource kind, and sidebar slots.

items.name: ui-session
items.title: UI session
items.description: Registers the screen's selection with the instance so an agent run captures what the person sees, and applies the intents the run sends back: open a resource's screen, select it on the current screen, or show a review.

items.name: os-deliveries
items.title: OS deliveries
items.description: Takes what OS requests from this session asked the frame to open, navigate to or prefill, acknowledges each, and holds prefills for capability forms.

items.name: os-browser
items.title: Browser OS input
items.description: Submits the link or shortcut a launch URL carries and the files an installed web app was launched with, and runs declared OS actions a page may perform itself.

items.name: os-provenance
items.title: OS provenance notice
items.description: Shows where a screen or a prefilled form the OS handed the application came from, with a dismiss or discard action.

items.name: accounts
items.title: Provider accounts
items.description: Connects agent provider accounts through the instance; the browser only ever sees safe metadata.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Sidebar with the application's title, context, a section slot, navigation with count badges and a status slot, and the capability palette (⌘K); a bar and menu sheet on a narrow viewport. Shows the build's best-before date, and a notice once it has passed. Exports NavigationCount, SidebarSection and SidebarLink.

items.name: frame
items.title: Application frame
items.description: Session-scoped query cache, live invalidation and hash routing around an application's screens, plus the launch-link exchange.
